ProjectDefaults.description:
What a new session in the project starts with. `global` and `runtimes`
have the shape of `session.create`'s members of the same names, and a
`session.create` that names the project and omits `runtimes` attaches
them. `agent` and `preset` name an agent and its preset as a
[`crate::RunSelection`] does; an agent without a preset is one of the
shared registry. The daemon never applies them: clients put them in a
new session's selection.

exposure.description:
The tool group and skill choices a new session in the project
starts with (client protocol 1.82.0;
`docs/site/specs/session-tool-groups.md` section 5.4): exact
selectors and skill names. The daemon copies them into a new
session's choices when `session.create` carries none of its own.

global.description:
Whether a new session attaches the global runtime; `true` when
omitted.

runtimes.description: The runtimes a new session attaches besides `global`, in order.

ProjectRuntime.description:
One runtime a project's new sessions attach, as `session.create`'s
`runtimes` names it.

capability.description:
The capability to attach; the runtime's only capability when
omitted.

workspace.description: Required exactly when the capability takes a workspace.

from_project.description:
Copied from the session's project's defaults when the session was
created, and not changed since.

ToolExposure.description:
One layer's rules: an agent document's, a project's defaults, or a
session's.

from_project.description:
Copied from the session's project's defaults when the session was
created, and not changed since.

oneOf.description:
Offered deferred, loaded with `tool_search`; `on` on a model that
does not defer and for an ACP agent.

description: Create a project, with an empty `overview` memory.

emoji.description:
Exactly one emoji: one extended grapheme cluster of at most 32
bytes that Unicode marks as an emoji, not ASCII, whitespace, or a
control character.

name.description: A name no other project has.
